U.note: Good snowfall and cozy cabin, but the blocky white highlights and skewed black base look off, and the readout text is crowded below.

V.note: Clean, clear flat daytime globe on a brown base, but snow clumps at the top and the whole thing is simple and washed out.

W.note: Charming shelf-room staging with a tilting globe and glitter on the ground, though the globe sits awkwardly on a wide base and the room is busy.

X.note: Elegant night scene with moon, smoke and glowing windows and tidy controls, but the globe starts fully settled and the shake is modest.

Y.note: Nice blue glass and brass collar, but the scene is dim and flat and the snow clusters in a clump instead of filling the dome.

Z.note: Most convincing glass, brass collar and wood base with a lit cabin and fine glitter that swirls and clears from the top, with sensible controls.
